title: Evidence relation and qualification shadow decision

estimand.name: claim_passage_relation
estimand.target: The relation of a passage to a claim under aligned scope
limitations: A typed model output is a proposal, not evidence authority
Context, support and refutation require independent qualification

relation.instructions: Classify only the evidential relation of PASSAGE to CLAIM, preserving scope, time, population, geography and denominator.

criteria.support: The passage directly supports all or a clearly delimited part of the claim under aligned scope.
criteria.refute: The passage directly contradicts a material part of the claim under aligned scope.
criteria.context: The passage is relevant or authentic context but does not directly support or refute the claim.
criteria.insufficient: The passage does not provide enough information to determine support, refutation or relevant context.

supports.instructions: Does the passage directly support the claim under aligned scope?

criteria.true: Direct support with compatible entity, time, geography, population, denominator and measure.
criteria.false: No direct support, including context only, mismatch, ambiguity or refutation.

refutes.instructions: Does the passage directly refute the claim under aligned scope?

criteria.true: Direct contradiction of a material claim component with compatible scope.
criteria.false: No direct refutation, including context only, mismatch, ambiguity or support.

evidence_strength.instructions: Rate the maximum evidential authority of this passage for this claim.

criteria.subclaim: Supports or refutes a delimited subclaim only.
criteria.whole_claim: Supports or refutes the whole claim under aligned scope.
